item.title: Aerodrome Slipstream fees “up 200%” in a month? One day did it.
item.description: The public series shows $8.08M of fees for Aerodrome Slipstream on 9 Sep, 33 times the median of the 14 days around it ($248.1K). With that day the 30-day change to 29 Sep 2026 is +200%; without it, +53%. Source: DefiLlama (daily fees), check by LV.
